description: Create A4 printable worksheets and separate answer keys; preserve supplied questions and format by default, with checked monochrome illustrations.

interface.defaultPrompt: Check for and apply available Worksheet Maker updates before starting, then recreate my supplied questions as A4 worksheets with checked monochrome illustrations and separate student and answer-key PDFs. interface.longDescription: Recreate supplied questions and their format as printable worksheets for any school subject, checking for and applying upstream skill updates before non-help work. Create or adapt practice only when explicitly requested. Check pictures, page layout, source coverage, and the final answer-key mapping.

name: worksheet-maker
